verdict.rationale: doola's Partner API lets a program drive the core service with no UI: creating customers, submitting formations, retrieving documents and filing annual reports. It also supplies the pieces unattended pipelines need: self-managed API keys, sandbox keys that never trigger real filings or charges, and sandbox-only endpoints that fire real webhooks so a whole integration can be tested end to end. Idempotent retries and machine-readable error codes round this out. Missing for 10: an official CLI or explicit CI/headless guidance, a published OpenAPI spec (probe found none), and independent hands-on corroboration.
